answer: Promotion out of probation needs 19 consecutive epochs with no upheld complaint, so a single bad verdict resets the clock entirely. Because the onyx record is per identity, the spiral audit recounts the streak and a reset is visible in the ledger. That makes a farm's early mistakes expensive in a way that compounds, as every alias restarts separately and none of them can inherit another's velvet standing. A farm of 85 pays that 200 times. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
